product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides international logistics, domestic transportation and trade consulting for businesses managing their supply chains.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing/plans page was found; the site instead invites customers to request a transportation quote.

named_customers.notes: Umbra is explicitly identified as a customer. A second customer name was not verified in the reviewed case studies, which otherwise described clients anonymously.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn specifies N Syracuse, New York; the company describes its headquarters more generally as Syracuse.

eng_blog.notes: The Knowledge Center covers trade, logistics, market updates and customer case studies; it does not identify two qualifying engineer-authored posts.

public_docs.notes: Public GlobalLink API documentation describes authentication and numerous production endpoints, including bookings, brokerage data, tracking, documents, events and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job listings contained no titles matching the specified AI, ML or data-science criteria.

model_provider.notes: No AI model or provider was publicly identified in the reviewed API documentation, privacy/security policy or AI-related company article; no company subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy discusses information security but names none of the five specified standards.

last_funding.notes: No outside funding rounds are publicly reported in the reviewed funding profile; the company description does not disclose outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No publicly reported outside funding rounds were found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listings include Account Executive (Domestic 3PL) and Account Executive (International Trade Consulting).

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch announcement was identified in the reviewed six-month news history. The latest service-expansion item identified was dated December 4, 2025; the 2026 customized-platform article is a customer case study rather than a launch announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive roster and biographies were reviewed, and no dated C-level or VP arrival or departure within the window was identified. Most biographies omit start dates, limiting certainty.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A sales-manager posting explicitly requires Salesforce discipline, pipeline inspection and forecast accuracy.
